headline: Congress in cruise control: both chambers convening only for pro forma sessions this week as business grinds to a halt

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on Tuesday, October 6, convening at 1:31 p.m. and adjourning just 33 seconds later. No legislative business was conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met in brief session on Tuesday, October 6, adjourning after just two minutes. Seventeen public bills and five resolutions were introduced, and committee reports on veterans affairs matters were filed, but no votes were taken.
